furnitures.description: Grey fabric with a textured pattern and a wooden or metal frame. Positioned against a wall, near the entrance.
furnitures.position: left side of the room, near the entrance

furnitures.description: A grey, cushioned armchair with a fabric covering and a minimalist design, placed near the sofa.
Round wooden dining table with a simple, light wood finish.
furnitures.position: center of the room, towards the right side

furnitures.description: Four chairs with a mix of upholstered fabric and wooden legs. Two are upholstered in a light green and navy blue, the other two are darker blue and light wood.
Small black metal side table with a round top, placed near the sofa.
Small wicker or woven ottoman with a yellow hue, placed near the sofa and armchair.
Light wooden TV stand with an open shelving design, holding a flat-screen TV.
furnitures.position: left side of the room, near the TV

furnitures.description: Wooden console or dresser with a light finish, holding decorative items and some books. It has a few drawers and a small shelf.
furnitures.position: right side of the room, near the dining table

furnitures.description: Large round mirror with a wooden frame, placed above the sofa.
Hanging light fixture with multiple glass spheres, suspended from the ceiling.
Large, neutral-toned rug with a woven pattern, placed under the sofa and armchair area.
A few potted plants of varying sizes, placed on shelves, the floor, and near windows.
furnitures.position: shelves, windowsill, and around the room

furnitures.description: Abstract or geometric wall art piece featuring earthy tones and geometric shapes, mounted on the wall near the dining table.
furnitures.position: right wall, above the dining table

furnitures.description: The room opens to another space via a sliding or regular door with a light-colored door frame.
furnitures.position: center of the background wall, connecting to another room

decorations.description: The walls are painted in a soft, muted teal or light blue shade, giving a calm and contemporary feel.
Natural light from large windows and the hanging spherical pendant light over the dining area.
Various cushions on the sofa and chairs, featuring neutral tones and vibrant accents like yellow and blue.
Small decorative items like candles, vases, and framed pictures on the console table and shelves.
decorations.position: on the console table and shelves

decorations.description: Decorative items hanging from the ceiling or walls, like the spherical pendant light.
